title: Cracking Ancient Codes: Cuneiform Writing - with Irving Finkel
summary: Irving Finkel of the British Museum lectures at the Royal Institution on the invention and decipherment of cuneiform writing in Mesopotamia, and why it is so hard to translate.
why: HN users recommend it as a delightful, well-told account of how cuneiform developed and was decoded.

quote.text: Highly recommend Prof Irving Fink's talk to Royal Institution on the 3,000 year development of cuneiform
